signals.title: Nebula Sans

signals.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
signals.why: OpenAI가 교육 기관과의 통합을 가속화하며 AI 기반 학습의 표준화 시도. 향후 세대의 AI 리터러시와 도입 관성에 영향.

signals.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous

signals.title: The Hugging Face incident and the road ahead

signals.title: Enabling independent research on how people use Claude

signals.title: How Claude's text watermarking works

signals.title: Intelligent transcription with Gemini 3.5 Transcribe
signals.why: Google의 멀티모달 모델 실용화 단계 진입으로 음성 처리 경험 업그레이드. 모바일·엔터프라이즈 영역 점유 경쟁 심화.

signals.title: Bomb fishing is wreaking havoc on Indonesia's coral reefs

signals.title: Building a backyard office, the build and cost breakdown

signals.title: How loveholidays is making everyone a builder with Codex

signals.title: Patterns and problems in multiagent systems
signals.why: AI 시대의 핵심 기술인 멀티에이전트 협력 구조의 근본적인 설계 과제를 다룹니다. AGI로 향하는 기술 로드맵 이해에 필수적입니다.

signals.title: FDA authorizes first wearable device that monitors ketone and blood sugar levels

signals.title: Firefox 157 will include JPEG XL by default on all platforms

signals.title: OpenAI Jalapeño: Better than Nvidia Blackwell

signals.title: Don't Wordle

signals.title: My Friend Aaron

signals.title: MS Paint and Photos inivisibly watermark even locally generated output with GUID

signals.title: Xiaomi: New CPU matches Apple cores single threaded, much faster multithreaded

signals.title: How Europe is killing makers and micro-entrepreneurs

signals.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro

signals.title: Discovering cryptographic weaknesses with Claude
signals.why: AI가 보안 감사 자동화를 가능하게 하면서 사이버 방어의 패러다임 전환을 시사합니다. 기업의 보안 인프라 투자 방식이 재편될 수 있습니다.

signals.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
signals.why: Google의 경량 고성능 모델은 온디바이스 AI 경쟁을 심화시키며, 엣지 컴퓨팅 기반 서비스의 수익성 문제를 풀어야 합니다.

signals.title: To become a better writer, read as much as you can

signals.title: typ.ing

signals.title: Why your local LLM feels dumber than it is

signals.title: Hister – A private, full content search index that you control

signals.title: Scrap (2006)

signals.title: ElevenLabs, TwelveLabs, ThirteenLabs

signals.title: Canada will match US tariffs 'dollar for dollar' as trade talks break down

signals.title: Canada suspends trade negotiations with USA and match tariffs dollar for dollar
